guide.profilePurposeTips1: Each profile is isolated and can simulate a unique device fingerprint. Use profiles to manage social media, e-commerce, tool, and other accounts separately. After creating multiple profiles, you can manage multiple accounts in one place.
guide.profilePurposeTips2: Support team members in managing accounts across devices while reducing account association and operation conflict risks.
guide.howUseTips1: After opening a profile, you can use fingerprint test sites to confirm whether the profile configuration meets expectations.
guide.howUseTips2: Log in to social media, e-commerce, tool, and other accounts in the profile, then use them according to your workflow to reduce account association risks.
guide.proxyPurposeTips1: IP is an important factor for isolating profiles and accounts. Many platforms recommend assigning a dedicated IP to each account to reduce association risks.
guide.proxyPurposeTips2: Configure a proxy during profile setup, use one IP per profile to prevent risk system flagging
guide.rpaWorkflowTips1: Let multiple profiles run the same RPA workflow in batches, such as browsing pages, submitting forms, or completing repeated actions.
guide.rpaWorkflowTips2: Choose a template from the RPA Marketplace and create an RPA task from it.
